Karnataka Approves Over ₹29,000 Crore in Investment Projects

Karnataka's government has approved investment proposals totaling ₹29,679 crore, which are projected to generate more than 66,000 jobs. The approved projects span various sectors, including aerospace, electronics, and renewable energy. Notable investments include those from Mahindra Aerostructures, Toyota Kirloskar, and Vibrancy Renewable Energies. Separately, hotel projects worth ₹315 crore were also given the go-ahead.
